# altertable_whoami (Data Source)

The principal and organization the configured API key authenticates as. Use it to scope `organization:*` role grants to your organization without hardcoding its ID (e.g. `resource_id = data.altertable_whoami.current.organization_id`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Identify the principal and organization behind the configured API key.
data "altertable_whoami" "current" {}

# Use the organization ID to scope an organization-level role grant without
# hardcoding it.
resource "altertable_role_set" "ci" {
  service_account_id = altertable_service_account.ci.id

  roles = [
    {
      role        = "organization:reader"
      resource_id = data.altertable_whoami.current.organization_id
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID.
- `organization_name` (String) Organization name.
- `organization_slug` (String) Organization slug.
- `principal_email` (String) Principal email (users only; empty for service accounts).
- `principal_id` (String) ID of the authenticated principal (user or service account).
- `principal_name` (String) Principal display name.
- `principal_type` (String) Principal type: `User` or `ServiceAccount`.
